reason: A multi-device collaboration plugin for connecting to and operating authorized DeepSeek Harness sessions from desktop, Android, or a browser, with workspace browsing and optional read-only file previews.

summaries.zh: 通过桌面端、Android 或浏览器连接并操作授权的远程 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持工作区浏览和可选的只读文件预览。
summaries.en: Connect to and operate authorized remote DeepSeek Harness sessions from desktop, Android, or a browser, with workspace browsing and optional read-only file previews.

capabilities: Connects authorized desktop and Android clients to a remote Harness host
Lists remote hosts, workspaces, and directories
Allows users to follow sessions, send text or image instructions, answer questions, and respond to permission requests
Provides optional read-only remote file previews through the dsh-file-viewer plugin
